verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
When the help of Allah comes, and the victory,

verses.ar: وَرَاَیۡتَ النَّاسَ یَدۡخُلُوۡنَ فِیۡ دِیۡنِ اللّٰہِ اَفۡوَاجًا ۙ﴿۳﴾
verses.en: And thou seest men entering the religion of Allah in troops,

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّکَ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡہُ ؕؔ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ تَوَّابًا ﴿٪۴﴾
verses.en: Glorify thy Lord, with His praise, and seek forgiveness of Him. Surely He is Oft-Returning with compassion.
